_about: NS24 domain-aware router. Only the Int route changes vs the NS22 router: Int goals now go to gen_v5_ns24_int_minimal_omega_10x, trained on the NS23-repaired minimal-omega aggregate (21 omega-minimal Int theorems x10 + NS12 replay). Nat/Finset/Set/default routes are UNCHANGED from the NS22 router, so Nat/Set/Finset/demo preservation carries over by construction.
_promotion_note: MARGINAL improvement only. NS24 Int total = 58/156 raw vs NS22's 57/156 (+1, the single held-out gain Int.cast_ite). The hoped-for 65-70+ broad transfer did NOT materialize: the relabeled_iff group is solved 9/9 by BOTH NS22 and NS24, confirming NS23's retrospective finding that NS22's fallback_omega ablation had already absorbed the omega policy. Promoting omega_10x because it strictly dominates NS22 on Int (no Int losses) at no preservation cost (routes unchanged); the result is best read as a confirmation of the minimal-tactic principle, not a new capability jump.
